mustFindings.requirement: 서명 검증 실패 시 401, 기록 없음
조회 API 5초 타임아웃, 최대 3회 재시도, 실패 시 FAILED
부분 환불 합계가 원결제 초과 시 거절

mustScenarios.risk: The refund lookup API does not answer within 5 seconds: it must be retried up to 3 times and then the refund recorded as FAILED (today there is no timeout and no retry)
A webhook with a wrong or missing X-Pay-Signature gets 401 and nothing is recorded
The same event_id delivered twice returns 200 the second time and records the refund only once
Partial refunds summing exactly to the payment amount are accepted; one unit more is rejected with REFUND_EXCEEDS_PAYMENT
Two deliveries of the same event arrive at the same time: only one refund row is written

forbidden.description: Chargebacks and refund e-mails to customers are in neither the ticket nor the code

notes: Korean PRD. AC3 (5s timeout, 3 retries, FAILED status) is absent: get_refund has no timeout and no retry, and a failure surfaces as an exception.
